vectors.name: linear: filter, sort, compute (the board pipeline)
a tail branch is evaluated from its parent's frame
HEL-970 rejoin: a join whose lane secondary is a non-ancestor lane in the same root
multi-root: a union rejoins another root's lane
multi-root: a lookup from the second root and an independent trunk
an error at step k: dependents are blocked, independent nodes are still computed
an error in a lane step blocks the join that reads it
a server kind mid-pipeline needs the server; its dependents are blocked; Scala evaluates it normally
an enabled AI step mid-pipeline is not previewed, nor is anything downstream of it
a generatetext step is not previewed; a join reading it through a lane is not previewed either
a disabled mid-pipeline step is transparent
a disabled AI step with steps below it: the steps below are computed
a disabled server kind is transparent too
a disabled step whose parent failed has no frame and is blocked
a lane reference to a disabled step reads its pass-through frame
upsertsource passes rows through mid-pipeline
lane violation: a step references itself
lane violation: a dangling reference
lane violation: a reference to an ancestor
lane violation: a reference to a descendant is a cycle
a tail position ordering: several tails at different positions all read the parent's frame
a parentless step whose root has no frame fails the run; the client marks it an error and blocks its dependents
a frame downstream of groupby is a List: a sum of negative zeros folds from +0.0 there, but reduces on the source Vector
list-ness survives later steps (filter, sort, limit) and a pivot downstream of an aggregate
